items.title: Mneme – Open-protocol AI memory that lives on your device
items.raw_excerpt: Hey guys, so I use AI a lot, and I mean a lot, specially for my job and just as a hobby, I've got ADHD so creating is somethign I love, but I always got annoyed that every AI memory product wants to host my data on their servers, in their schema, locked to their product. Sooooo I built mneme memory that lives on your device, encrypted with keys only you hold, with an open protocol that works across Claude,Cursor, ChatGPT, Gemini. Apache 2.0, on npm. https://github.com/ppserapiao/mneme · https://mneme-web-zeta.vercel.app Let me know your thoughts ;)

title_i18n.en: Mneme – Open-protocol AI memory that lives on your device
title_i18n.zh: Mneme – 运行在你设备上的开放协议AI记忆
title_i18n.es: Mneme: memoria de IA de protocolo abierto que reside en tu dispositivo.

excerpt_i18n.en: Hey guys, so I use AI a lot, and I mean a lot, specially for my job and just as a hobby, I've got ADHD so creating is somethign I love, but I always got annoyed that every AI memory product wants to host my data on their servers, in their schema, locked to their product. Sooooo I built mneme memory that lives on your device, encrypted with keys only you hold, with an open protocol that works across Claude,Cursor, ChatGPT, Gemini. Apache 2.0, on npm. https://github.com/ppserapiao/mneme · https://mneme-web-zeta.vercel.app Let me know your thoughts ;)
excerpt_i18n.zh: 嘿，我经常用AI，真的非常频繁，尤其是工作和业余爱好。我有注意力缺陷多动症，所以很喜欢创作，但一直让我恼火的是，每个AI记忆产品都想把我的数据托管在它们自己的服务器上。
excerpt_i18n.es: Chicos, uso mucho la IA, y cuando digo mucho es mucho, especialmente para mi trabajo y también como hobby. Tengo TDAH, así que crear es algo que me encanta, pero siempre me molestó que todos los productos de memoria de IA quieran alojar mis datos en sus servidores.

items.title: Microsoft reports AI is more expensive than paying human employees
items.raw_excerpt: Microsoft's internal report reveals that AI systems can be more expensive than human employees for certain tasks, raising questions about AI investment returns.

title_i18n.en: Microsoft reports AI is more expensive than paying human employees
title_i18n.zh: 微软报告称，使用人工智能比雇佣人类员工更昂贵。
title_i18n.es: Microsoft informa de que la IA es más cara que pagar a empleados humanos.

excerpt_i18n.en: Microsoft's internal report reveals that AI systems can be more expensive than human employees for certain tasks, raising questions about AI investment returns.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 微软内部报告显示，其AI系统的运行成本在某些情况下高于雇佣人类员工完成相同任务的成本。这一发现引发了对AI投资回报率的质疑，尤其是在企业大规模部署AI代理的背景下。

items.title: Making Deep Learning Go Brrrr from First Principles (2022)

title_i18n.en: Making Deep Learning Go Brrrr from First Principles (2022)
title_i18n.zh: 从基本原理出发让深度学习飞速运转（2022）
title_i18n.es: Haciendo que el Deep Learning vaya Brrrr desde los Primeros Principios (2022)

excerpt_i18n.en: This article explores how to accelerate deep learning training from first principles, covering computation graph optimization, memory hierarchy utilization, and parallelization strategies. It explains the underlying efficient implementation of modern deep learning frameworks like PyTorch.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 本文从第一性原理出发，探讨了如何加速深度学习训练，涵盖了计算图优化、内存层次利用和并行化策略等核心概念。作者通过逐步推导，解释了现代深度学习框架（如PyTorch）底层的高效实现原理。
